author: Francesco Giannicola

current_frontier.representation: six C2 x C3 character channels of a generic marked j0 cyclic genus-one packet

smallest_decisive_experiment: Complete the k20 maximal-residue scans at several good primes, intersect the congruence conditions, then run all three K3 channels only on surviving rational markings. A marking is promoted only if it attains finite-field ranks (4,6,6) at every completed good prime.
certificate_policy: No promotion above Level 0 without explicit rational points and exact independence evidence. Finite-characteristic Picard ranks are rejection or prioritization evidence only.
